name: tim-monorepo
description: TiM Work Order Management System - Monorepo

scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format:all: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf backend/node_modules backend/dist frontend/node_modules frontend/dist node_modules

author: TiM Development Team
